title: Surface raw max cosine sim on hits and add not_path exclusion filter to search_code

sections.what: Surface raw best cosine similarity (`sim`) alongside RRF `score` in _compact() / search results, and add `not_path: str | list[str] | None` (`AND f.rel_path NOT LIKE ?`) across keyword and semantic filtering.
sections.why: RRF score alone hides whether cosine similarity was 0.88 or 0.46, and not_terms cannot reliably exclude path prefixes like dev_tasks/ because split_words tokenizes underscores.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_codesearch_db.py verifying sim field and not_path filtering.

acceptance.text: Every search_code hit includes sim (raw best cosine similarity across vec:* lists, or null when keyword-only).
search_code and Searcher.search support not_path (str | list[str]) filtering out matching rel_path prefixes/substrings in both FTS and semantic allowed checks.
Unit tests verify sim surfacing and not_path exclusion for paths like dev_tasks/ and tests/.

evidence: Surfaced raw max cosine `sim` on materialized hits in src/codesearch/search.py and `_compact()` in src/codesearch/mcp_server.py.
Added `not_path: str | list[str] | None` exclusion filter across Searcher.search(), Searcher.keyword(), Searcher._allowed(), Searcher._filters(), and search_code().
